description: DEMO portfolio (synthetic, shared, read-only). Read one slice of the illustrative tax-lot orientation (the Taxes tab) instead of the whole context. view is required: 'maturities' = the open lots whose time test is coming up, soonest first (date; daysToExempt = days left until that date, the Taxes tab's 'N days to go'; symbol, qty, valueEur); 'openLots' = the per-asset lot lines, largest position first (openQty, taxFreeQty, taxFreeValueEur, nextMaturity, warnings); 'annual' = the realized-gains table per year, newest year first (proceedsEur = gross, feesEur = broker fees deducted, timeExemptGainEur, capTaxableGainEur = the part of time-test gains the exempt-proceeds cap taxed, netTaxableGainEur, estimatedTaxEur); 'ytd' = this year's proceeds against the limit, the exempt-proceeds cap (exemptGainsCap: time-test-exempt proceeds, scope 'crypto' from 2026), what is already sellable tax-free and the next maturity. symbol (one ticker) or symbols (several, in one call) filter maturities and openLots; year filters annual; limit is 1-50 (default 10) with offset/nextOffset. Every answer carries activeRules. Approximate orientation only — not tax advice and never input for a tax report. Each '…Eur' field now also ships under its currency-neutral name (amountEur→amount, buyEur→buy, valueEur→value, totalEur→totalAmount); the '…Eur' twins are DEPRECATED and will be removed — read the neutral name.

symbols.description: Narrow to SEVERAL tickers in one call — the batch form of symbol, up to 25. The two are mutually exclusive.
